capabilities: Export a single note as a one-chapter EPUB
Export a folder of notes as a book, with subfolders as Parts
Export a note plus its linked notes to a chosen depth
Preview a book's chapter order before building it
Push finished books to an Onyx Boox device over Wi-Fi
disambiguation: Not a handwriting or ink-annotation tool; it only converts notes into EPUB books.
extras: Pushing to a Boox needs the BooxDrop app and both devices on the same Wi-Fi network; the local EPUB is always written first. No telemetry, analytics or account. The README notes that how a Boox library displays the book detail fields has not been checked on a device yet.
motivation: The author built it so notes can be read comfortably on an e-ink device instead of a laptop screen.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into a book that reads well on an e-ink device, with chapters, covers, footnotes and a navigable table of contents.

relations.evidence: every export is uploaded straight to the device's library after it saves

requires.name: BooxDrop on an Onyx Boox device

summary: Exports notes, folders, or linked notes as EPUB 3 books for e-ink readers, with optional Wi-Fi delivery to an Onyx Boox device.
